lines.en: Ben, this fair is huge. A large number of people came, and a great deal of effort went into the stands.
lines.pt: Ben, esta feira está enorme. Um grande número de pessoas veio, e muito esforço foi dedicado às barracas.

lines.en: The majority of the visitors are local families, and a great deal of money is being spent at the stalls.
lines.pt: A maioria dos visitantes são famílias locais, e muito dinheiro está sendo gasto nas barracas.

lines.en: A large number of vendors asked for a place, but the organizers could only accept a small number of them.
lines.pt: Um grande número de vendedores pediu um lugar, mas os organizadores só puderam aceitar um pequeno número deles.

lines.en: A large number of the stands sell similar food, so variety matters more than quantity.
lines.pt: Um grande número de barracas vende comida parecida, então variedade importa mais que quantidade.

lines.en: But a great deal of time was spent choosing the vendors, and the majority of the committee preferred local products.
lines.pt: Mas muito tempo foi gasto escolhendo os vendedores, e a maioria do comitê preferiu produtos locais.

lines.en: Is it true that a great deal of the profit goes to the school, or is that only a rumor?
lines.pt: É verdade que boa parte do lucro vai para a escola, ou isso é só um boato?

lines.en: The majority of the profit is promised to the school library, which is being repaired, so every ticket helps.
lines.pt: A maior parte do lucro é prometida à biblioteca da escola, que está sendo reformada, então cada ingresso ajuda.

lines.en: I will buy more tickets. A large number of my colleagues said they would come if somebody invited them.
lines.pt: Vou comprar mais ingressos. Um grande número de colegas meus disse que viria se alguém os convidasse.

lines.en: Last year a small number of them came, because a great deal of advertising was done too late.
lines.pt: No ano passado um pequeno número deles veio, porque muita publicidade foi feita tarde demais.

lines.en: The posters were hung early, and the majority of the neighbors told me that they had heard about it.
lines.pt: Os cartazes foram colados cedo, e a maioria dos vizinhos me disse que já tinha ouvido falar.

lines.en: Let us walk around before it is crowded, and then count how many people wait at the gate.
lines.pt: Vamos dar uma volta antes que lote, e depois contar quantas pessoas esperam no portão.

facts.sub: a great deal of, a large number of, the majority of.

facts.label: a large number of + plural
facts.sub: Use a large number of com substantivos contáveis no plural: a large number of people, vendors, tickets. O verbo concorda com o plural: A large number of vendors asked for a place.

facts.label: a great deal of + incontável
facts.sub: Use a great deal of com incontáveis: a great deal of money, time, effort. Não use com people ou vendors. A great deal of effort went into the stands.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: A great deal of is used with uncountable nouns.
items.why: Yes: a great deal of money.

items.s: We say “a great deal of people”.
items.why: We say a large number of people.

items.s: A majority of means most of a group.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: A great deal of is used with uncountable nouns. → Verdadeiro (Yes: a great deal of money.)
We say “a great deal of people”. → Falso (We say a large number of people.)
A majority of means most of a group. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A busy neighborhood fair · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm Saturday in Miami. Alma arrives early at the neighborhood fair. Colorful stands fill the street near the school. Music comes from a small stage in the corner. Ben meets her at the entrance. Together they begin to look around.

“Ben, this fair is huge. A large number of people came, and a great deal of effort went into the stands.” says Alma. “The majority of the visitors are local families, and a great deal of money is being spent at the stalls.” says Ben. “A large number of vendors asked for a place, but the organizers could only accept a small number of them.” says Alma.
